<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

function session_initialisieren(): void
{
    if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_ACTIVE) {
        return;
    }

    session_set_cookie_params([
        'lifetime' => 0,
        'path' => '/',
        'secure' => request_ist_https(),
        'httponly' => true,
        'samesite' => 'Lax',
    ]);

    session_name('hermclaw_session');
    session_start();
    csrf_formular_token_injizieren();
}

function csrf_token(): string
{
    $token = (string)($_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '');
    if ($token === '') {
        $token = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = $token;
    }
    return $token;
}

function csrf_input(): string
{
    return '<input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="' . htmlspecialchars(csrf_token(), ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8') . '">';
}

function csrf_request_gueltig(): bool
{
    $token = (string)($_POST['csrf_token'] ?? $_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? '');
    $session_token = (string)($_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '');
    return $token !== '' && $session_token !== '' && hash_equals($session_token, $token);
}

function csrf_schutz_pruefen(): void
{
    if (csrf_request_gueltig()) {
        return;
    }

    http_response_code(400);
    $accept = (string)($_SERVER['HTTP_ACCEPT'] ?? '');
    $content_type = (string)($_SERVER['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '');
    if (str_contains($accept, 'application/json') || str_contains($content_type, 'application/json')) {
        header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
        echo json_encode(['ok' => false, 'fehler' => 'Ungueltige Sicherheitsanfrage'], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
    } else {
        echo 'Ungueltige Sicherheitsanfrage';
    }
    exit;
}

function csrf_formular_token_injizieren(): void
{
    if (PHP_SAPI === 'cli' || headers_sent()) {
        return;
    }

    ob_start(static function (string $html): string {
        if (!str_contains(strtolower($html), 'method="post"') && !str_contains(strtolower($html), "method='post'")) {
            return $html;
        }

        return (string)preg_replace(
            '/(<form\b[^>]*\bmethod=["\']post["\'][^>]*>)(?!\s*<input[^>]+name=["\']csrf_token["\'])/i',
            '$1' . csrf_input(),
            $html
        );
    });
}

function session_angemeldet(): bool
{
    return !empty($_SESSION['benutzer_id']);
}

function session_benutzer_id(): int
{
    return (int)($_SESSION['benutzer_id'] ?? 0);
}

function session_anmelden(array $benutzer): void
{
    session_regenerate_id(true);
    $_SESSION['benutzer_id'] = (int)$benutzer['id'];
    $_SESSION['benutzername'] = (string)$benutzer['benutzername'];
    $_SESSION['anzeigename'] = (string)$benutzer['anzeigename'];
    $_SESSION['rechte'] = benutzer_rechte_laden((int)$benutzer['id']);
    $_SESSION['angemeldet_am'] = time();
    sessions_registrieren((int)$benutzer['id']);
}

function session_abmelden(): void
{
    $_SESSION = [];
    if (ini_get('session.use_cookies')) {
        $parameter = session_get_cookie_params();
        setcookie(session_name(), '', time() - 42000, $parameter['path'], $parameter['domain'] ?? '', (bool)$parameter['secure'], (bool)$parameter['httponly']);
    }
    session_destroy();
}
